gaps.explanation: Statement of Activities pp2-3 (printed pp5-6) business-type receipts: Water charges 59,269 + Sewer charges 18,210 + Interest 253 + Other 39,681 = 117,413. The proprietary funds statement p7 (printed p10), which detail follows, prints operating receipts Water 59,269 + 21,977, Sewer 18,210 + 17,704 = 117,159 (all in detail; detail sum 117,160 incl. the report's own 1 rounding) and prints Interest income 253 (Water Fund) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), so detail carries it in section other financing (+253). Gap 253 = the interest income shown in another section. All printed lines are in detail; no fix.

Statement of Activities p2 (printed p5) business-type disbursements: Water 67,582 + Sewer 66,749 + Debt service Principal 20,000 + Interest and other charges 4,843 = 159,174. The proprietary funds statement p7 (printed p10) prints total operating disbursements 134,331 (Water 67,582 + Sewer 66,749; all lines in detail) and prints the debt service (Principal 20,000, Interest expense 4,825, Wire fees 18; Total debt service 24,843) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES); detail records those as other financing (-20,000, -4,825, -18). 134,331 + 24,843 = 159,174. Gap 24,843 = debt service shown in another section; no fix.
